description: A tombstoned node still serves a valid link set carrying the tombstone instant; a peer check reports it resolved-not-mutual, and a walk does not descend into it. Node b links back to a, so only the tombstone makes the check resolved-not-mutual; a successor named by alternate is never treated as the same node.
